svg.title: RunyShark — expertise
svg.desc: Expertise: 117 technologies across 10 domains, every domain at Expert level. AI & Agents (Expert): Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Claude API, OpenAI API, Gemini, MCP, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, Ollama, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Multi-agent orchestration, Agent harnesses, Prompt engineering. RAG & Retrieval (Expert): Embeddings, Vector search, pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, Redis Vector, Hybrid search, Reranking, Evals & guardrails. Automation (Expert): n8n, Zapier, Make, GitHub Actions, Webhooks, BullMQ queues, Cron & schedulers, Tool calling. Languages (Expert): TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, Bash, PowerShell, HTML5, CSS, SCSS, Handlebars, MDX, GraphQL, Markdown, JSON, YAML. Frontend & Mobile (Expert): React 19, Next.js 15, React Native, Expo 54, Electron, Angular, Astro, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI, shadcn/ui, NativeWind, Styled Components, Sass, MUI, Zustand, Redux, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, React Router, RxJS, Framer Motion, Storybook. Backend & APIs (Expert): NestJS 11, Node.js, Bun, Express, FastAPI, GraphQL, REST & OpenAPI, WebSockets, JWT, Stripe, Strapi, Microservices, Event-driven. Cloud & Infra (Expert): AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Vercel, Cloudflare, Firebase, Supabase, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Serverless. Databases (Expert): PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Prisma 7, Sequelize, TypeORM. Testing & Quality (Expert): Jest, Vitest, Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, Stryker, Postman. DevOps & Tools (Expert): Turborepo, GitHub Actions, Git, GitHub, ESLint, Babel, Jira, Slack, Trello.
